subject: [hw] DONE V33
body:
DONE V33 (shim/n2vfs.c + shim/n2shim_stdio.c + shim/test_v33). Host-tested only; no phone, nothing published or committed.

Test command (work-tree root):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
Last lines:
  N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
  N2TEST V33 PASS 288/288            (ASan+UBSan -O1)
  N2TEST V33 PASS 288/288            (plain -O2)
  N2TEST V33 PASS 288/288            (TSan -O1, per-thread guest errno)
About 76 s on one CPU; artifacts only under /tmp/n2hw-v33 (~4 MB). Extra: bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/compile_ios.sh -> N2TEST V33-IOS PASS 2/2 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only).

Implemented (interfaces exactly as include/n2elf.h):
- n2vfs_register (16 devices, exact path, -EINVAL/-EEXIST/-ENOSPC), guest fds 100..163, open/__open_2/close/read/write/ioctl dispatch to the device, ioctl device>=0 passed through else guest -1 + errno, n2vfs_mmap forwarding to the device, __errno = per-guest-thread 4-byte guest word, guest Linux errno values (host errnos and open flags translated for Darwin).
- Virtual read-only files: /proc/cpuinfo (4x A55 0xd05 + 4x A78 0xd41 per mt6893.dts), /proc/device-tree/chosen/atag,devinfo (devinfo_tag, 884 bytes, data_size 220, data[3]=0x80000000), cpu0-7 topology/physical_package_id (0/0/0/0/1/1/1/2) and of_node/compatible. Everything else ENOENT, including /sys/bus/platform/drivers/dev_info/dev_info and the PPM/cpufreq/oppidx files (formats unknown; inventing frequency data would lie to the rate-control path).
- n2shim_stdio[] = the exact 27 stdio imports. FILE* 1=stdout 2=stderr 3..63=fopen; n2shim_log(prio,tag,text) global (stdout 4/stdout, stderr 6/stderr, NULL = discard); fprintf/printf/puts via V30 n2fmt; fscanf via V30 n2fmt_vscan; __fread_chk = (dst,size,nmemb,fp,dst_len) with the 5th on the stack (evidence: libvpud_vcodec.so 0xf000-0xf00e); fopen maps /data and /sdcard below $N2HW_DUMP_DIR (else ENOENT) and opens other paths on the host; fread/fwrite/fgets/feof/fflush/fseek/fileno/fsync; clock_gettime/gettimeofday in the 32-bit-time_t guest layout; exit/abort/__stack_chk_fail record the first reason, set stop_request, call V32 n2shim_thread_request_stop() weakly, never exit the host.

Not done / limits (full list in dsh-state/workers/V33/STATUS.md): not linked into the daemon or run on the phone; devices have no read/write callback in the frozen struct (EINVAL); virtual files are read-only (the two write-only sysfs control opens get ENOENT); /sys/bus/platform/drivers/dev_info/dev_info content unknown -> ENOENT (asked D01); unmapped guest pointers inside the range are not detectable by the shim (core turns the SIGSEGV into STOP_FAULT inside n2a32_run); fseek returns int (2 GiB); write(1/2) truncates the log line at 65535; 64 fds / 64 FILE slots / 64 errno words / 16 devices; no atexit in exit(); one FILE*/fd per thread.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/shim/n2vfs.c, gpu/hwcodec/shim/n2shim_stdio.c, gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/{t_main.c,run_tests.sh,compile_ios.sh}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V33/STATUS.md. No other package file touched.

Extras exported for integrators (no frozen header declares them; repeat the declarations): void (*n2shim_log)(int,const char*,const char*); n2shim_stdio_exit_reason/exit_status/exit_pc/exit_clear(); n2shim_stdio_set_stderr_symbol(uint32_t).
Facts posted to D01: devinfo parse (word at file offset 0x10, bits 6/7/8/10/11/12), the live-DT data[3] value, the OAL parse formats, and the __fread_chk argument order.
Staying available for review findings.
